definitions.explanation: A political and economic philosophy that puts individual freedom first and limits the role of the state, in politics and in the market.

examples.japanese: {自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧。
{自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}⟦{陣営|じんえい}→陣営：14662_jinei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一員|いちいん}→一員：08920_ichiin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Postwar Japan became a member of the liberal (Western) bloc.

notes:
A formal word from politics, economics, and history. In Cold War contexts {自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}⟦{陣営|じんえい}→陣営：14662_jinei⟧ or {自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}{国|こく} meant the Western bloc, as opposed to the ⟦{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ}→社会主義：05415_shakaishugi⟧ or ⟦{共産主義|きょうさんしゅぎ}→共産主義：16623_kyousanshugi⟧ countries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧: a free-market economy
- {自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}⟦{陣営|じんえい}→陣営：14662_jinei⟧: the liberal (Western) bloc
- {新自由主義|しんじゆうしゅぎ}: neoliberalism

WATCH OUT:
It does not carry the American sense of "left-leaning"; for that, ⟦リベラル→リベラル：11707_riberaru⟧ is used.
